استأنست (form X)
# اِسْتَأْنَسْتُ (istaʔnastu) /is.taʔ.nas.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# اِسْتَأْنَسْتَ (istaʔnasta) /is.taʔ.nas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# اِسْتَأْنَسْتِ (istaʔnasti) /is.taʔ.nas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# اِسْتَأْنَسَتْ (istaʔnasat) /is.t
